input.quote: Provisions that should reasonably be considered to survive termination of the Agreement will survive and be enforceable after such termination or expiration, including without limitation provisions relating to confidentiality, proprietary rights, indemnification, limitations of liability, effects of termination, and governing Law.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or other restrictive covenant binding the Customer. Searches for "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "hire", "personnel" and "compete" return no hiring-restriction language: the only "hire"/"employed" references are in the mutual indemnities (p0051, p0052) describing acts of third parties under a party's control, and "employees" otherwise appears only in the liability exclusion (p0027), indemnity beneficiary lists (p0047, p0052) and the confidentiality permitted-disclosure provision (p0061). The general provisions (p0064–p0073) cover governing law, publicity, independent contractor status, fees, notices, severability/survival, force majeure, assignment and counterparts, and the survival list at p0070 includes no restrictive covenant. This matches the preferred position of no non-solicit on the Customer, so no redline is required.
